name: LRCLIB
author: Viboplr
description: Synced and plain lyrics from LRCLIB

assistant.instructions: Synced/plain lyrics from lrclib.net. For a KNOWN track use GET /v1/lyrics (add pluginId=lrclib to force this provider over local files). search_lyrics is for when exact metadata fails or is unknown: a free-text search returning candidate matches to disambiguate from.

tools.name: search_lyrics
tools.description: Free-text search of the LRCLIB catalog (title/artist keywords) — returns candidate tracks with whether synced lyrics exist. Use when an exact title+artist lookup came back empty

informationTypes.name: Lyrics
informationTypes.description: Song lyrics, synced or plain text
